# A server entry another device moves into a taken-along folder between the Discard answer and its build is not one of the folder's entries, so deleting it changes it alone, with and without a restart; one the server held below the folder at the answer still is.
# An edit, rename or move of an entry another device brings into a taken-along folder, alone or inside a folder, changes that entry alone with and without a restart, a store from before arrivals were recorded keeps the earlier behaviour, and an entry the user creates or moves in below such an entry, or moves into another taken-along folder, still makes the discarded folder the user's.
# An edit in a held folder a first-link Discard dropped inside a trashed server folder is sent under that folder while the folder above stays discarded, with and without a restart; the tests apply the server's result and check the folder comes back and nothing more is sent, the contrast with no edit, and an edit before the build asking again.
# What began an entry's current stay in a taken-along folder decides whether it is an arrival: this device's confirmed move into the folder from outside it, applied from its own result or from the log, makes a later change count against the folder, also after another device's in-place edit and when another device moved the entry elsewhere in the folder first; a move within the folder by either device keeps an arrival an arrival, pending or confirmed, also for a child that came with an arrival folder and while another device moves the arrival out and back; an arrival another device moves out and back in, or into a folder this device brought in, stays an arrival; an entry it put in a folder before the Discard came with that folder, one it put there after the Discard did not; an entry the user moved in before the answer that another device moves elsewhere in the folder before the build is not one of its entries; this device moving an arrival out and back in makes the folder the user's; a Discard asked again forgets the folders its answer would take along.
# Only a placement that crosses into the folder decides: an entry this device moves into an outside folder that another device then brings in came with that folder, and an arrival this device moves into an outside folder it then brings in makes the folder the user's; the user's move into the folder stays an addition when another device made the same move first or second, sent or not.
# A record that doesn't bring an entry from outside the folder into it decides nothing, whichever device made it: an entry another device moves into an outside folder that this device then brings in came with that folder, from this device's own result or from the log, and so does one another device moved between outside folders; an arrival or a folder holding one that another device moves out goes with the folder this device brings in later; an entry another device moves out before this device applies the move still counts by its earlier record, with an edit or a further move there; a later arrival into a folder this device brought in is an arrival.
# A stay that began before the Discard still decides: an entry another device moved out before the answer that this device still has in the folder is an arrival, so editing it changes it alone, with and without a restart. The user's move into the folder counts as this device's record when another device moved the entry elsewhere in the folder first, or brought in the folder it came from, from this device's own result or from the log, downloaded or not. A change to an entry another device moves out between the answer and the build changes the folder, and this device's move of an arrival within the folder keeps it an arrival while another device moves it out and back.
# A server commit counts as one step: an entry it moves within a folder it brings in is an arrival in either record order. This device's move into the folder stays its own when another device moves the entry out before the answer, through either acknowledgement path and across a restart. Stays are recorded only from the first link until its question and Discard records close: a first link that holds nothing, or ordinary sync, records none even at 21k entries, the stays survive a restart unchanged and go when the question closes, a store upgraded with a question open counts no entry as another device's, an entry this device creates in the folder counts as its own once acknowledged, also after a crash before the acknowledgement is stored, and the store writes the acknowledgement and its stay in one transaction. A store from before stays were recorded counts an entry another device brought in as this device's, and an entry that comes with a folder another device moves in during the answer window is not one of its entries after this device moves it within the folder.
# Only this device's stays are recorded: with first-link state open, 1,000 creates by another device in an unrelated folder write no rows, while a question waits and while an excluded entry keeps the state; another device bringing an entry this device moved in back into the folder, alone, inside a folder, or in one commit that moves a folder in and its child within it, removes this device's rows and makes the entry another device's, across a restart; an entry another device creates after the answer is another device's with no row; a folder this device moves in that the server renames, and a restore this device sends, count as this device's with everything below once acknowledged. Two nested questions keep the stays until the outer closes, a folder taken again after its own question closed is still kept by this device's stays, and a store upgraded with a question open counts no entry as another device's until the last question and Discard record close, whichever question opens second, after which a new link records again.
# Entries this device moves or creates into a folder it creates that the server merges into another folder count as this device's once acknowledged, with and without a restart and through either acknowledgement path.
# These outcomes depend on persisted Discard state and on server changes between the answer, the build and the user's change, which no existing first_link test sets up.
# A Discard's membership counts each entry R holds below the folder at the answer unless the user deleted it or moved it out of the folder: a copy left behind by another device's move, deleted or edited where it was, keeps the entry one of the folder's entries; a delete or a move out the user made does not, also when the move lands in a held folder that is published; a move out into a held folder that the same or a later Discard takes back leaves the entry one of the folder's entries, a file or a folder; each with and without a restart.
# A delete of an entry another device creates in a taken-along folder after the Discard answer changes that entry alone: the held folder stays discarded and the server folder goes back to R's place, with and without a restart.
# An entry another device moves from one taken-along folder into another before the answer belongs to the folder R holds it in at the answer, with and without a restart. A late acknowledgement of this device's move records no stay for an entry another device has since moved into a taken-along folder, whether this device's own record arrived first or not, with and without a restart. An entry this device moves from folder to folder keeps only the stays of the folders it is still in. A store whose frozen answer lists a member without its folder reads the answer as one frozen before members were listed, the upgrade from the release fixture keeps a frozen member's folder, and reading frozen answer rows can be abandoned at each row.
# A move of this device's out of a taken-along folder that the server refuses ends no stay: the entry goes back, keeps this device's stay there, and a later edit still makes the discarded folder the user's, with and without a restart.
# A move of this device's into a taken-along folder that another device moves out before this device reads the move's own record or its result records no stay, so with the local copy still in the folder a later edit changes that entry alone, with and without a restart.
# The rules-gated case where another device moves an entry out of the server folder before the answer and the user edits its stale copy also checks that the taken-along folder goes back to the place R holds, with and without a restart.
# Review follow-ups pin four first-link Discard outcomes the stay rules decide, each with a restart where state is reloaded: one commit that moves an outside folder in with an arrival moved into it reclaims the folder; an entry the user moves into the folder while its rename waits stays an addition after another device brings its folder in, and the rename alone does not; a change to the conflict copy of an edit to an arrival changes that copy alone; an entry this device creates before the answer stays one of the folder's entries when another device moves it within the folder before the acknowledgement. The existing tests now also check the rename they are named for, the reclaim's move of the taken-along folder, the move recorded from the log before the result, the tombstone this device's delete records, the holds a reload restores, and that an engine state read stops during its frozen rows.
# Every stay and membership test that applies this device's result also runs in the driver's order, where the commit's own record is acknowledged and settled before the result arrives: creates, moves, restores, a folder the server renames, a folder the server merges into another, a conflict copy, the held-folder edit in a trashed server folder, the stay lifecycle across nested and reopened questions and a store upgrade, and a move into the folder that another device moves out before the result, which keeps the folder. Without the fix, 17 of these tests fail in that order.
# This device's move out of a taken-along folder ends its stay there on whichever of its own record and its result comes first, with and without a restart, and a later edit changes that entry alone; a refused move out keeps the stay when its commit's record is acknowledged before the result.
